name: Pin
description: A row of single-character cells for one-time codes. One real input with autocomplete=one-time-code drives the cells, so SMS autofill and paste fill every cell at once.

props.name: length
props.description: The number of cells. Sets maxlength on the control.

props.name: type
props.description: The characters allowed. Numeric sets inputmode=numeric; other characters are dropped as people type or paste.

props.name: mask
props.description: Shows a dot for each character and makes the control a password input.

props.name: groupSize
props.description: Draws a separator after every groupSize cells, such as 3 for a 3 + 3 code.

props.name: label
props.description: The visible label, linked to the control.

props.name: hint
props.description: Help text under the cells, linked with aria-describedby.

props.name: error
props.description: Validation message. Marks the code invalid and is linked with aria-describedby.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the code invalid without a message. Emitted as data-invalid.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the code required and shows the required mark.

props.name: value
props.description: The code. Livewire binds it with wire:model, Vue with v-model.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial code of an uncontrolled pin.

props.name: errorField
props.description: The validation key to read from $errors. Defaults to the wire:model name.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { cell: '…', label: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The field: label, cells, hint and error.

parts.name: label
parts.description: The visible label, for the control.

parts.name: required
parts.description: The required mark inside the label. Hidden from screen readers; the control is required.

parts.name: cells
parts.description: The row of cells, with the control laid over it.

parts.name: control
parts.description: The one native input, transparent over the cells, with autocomplete=one-time-code. Attributes other than class land here.

parts.name: cell
parts.description: One character cell (aria-hidden). Emits data-filled, and data-active on the cell the next character goes in.

events.name: complete
events.description: Every cell is filled. Use it to submit the code.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to the code; typing fills the next cell.

requirements: One native input holds the whole code, so SMS autofill (autocomplete=one-time-code), paste and screen readers work on it as one field.
The cells are aria-hidden mirrors of the input's value.
The label is linked with for/id; hint and error with aria-describedby.
Invalid sets aria-invalid on the control; the error is text, never color alone.
Visible focus ring on the active cell while the control has :focus-visible.
Never clear the code on error without saying so.

parts.error: That code has expired. We sent a new one.
